title: TEDxTokyo — 日本のイノベーションを再考する (Rethinking Japanese Innovation)
description: A TEDxTokyo talk in Japanese examining Japan's innovation challenges: why a nation known for quality manufacturing (カイゼン, monozukuri) has struggled with digital transformation (DX). The speaker argues for a cultural shift from perfectionism to experimentation. N2–N3 formal Japanese with technical vocabulary.
